usage: The word '退燒藥' refers to medicine used specifically to reduce fever.
'退燒藥' functions as a noun in a sentence and can be the subject or object.
You can say, '我需要退燒藥' (I need fever medicine) as a simple statement using this noun.
'退燒藥' often appears in contexts related to health and illness discussions.
It is common to ask questions or give advice involving '退燒藥', like '你食咗退燒藥未？' (Have you taken fever medicine yet?).
